title: RunService
summary: The frame loop: Heartbeat (every frame, after physics), Stepped (before physics), RenderStepped (client only, before render). Also tells you where you're running: IsServer/IsClient/IsStudio.

events.name: Heartbeat
events.description: Every frame, AFTER physics simulation. Client and server. deltaTime = seconds since last frame. The workhorse for per-frame logic.

events.name: Stepped
events.description: Every physics step, BEFORE simulation. Use for physics-sensitive writes.

events.name: RenderStepped
events.description: Client ONLY, just before rendering. Ideal for camera updates and UI-critical per-frame work. Heavy work here hurts FPS directly.

methods.name: IsServer / IsClient
methods.description: Which runtime am I in? Works in the same script to branch logic.

methods.name: IsStudio
methods.description: Am I running inside Roblox Studio (test or edit)?

methods.name: BindToRenderStep
methods.signature: RunService:BindToRenderStep(name: string, priority: number, fn: (dt: number) -> ())
methods.description: Register a named RenderStepped callback with explicit ordering priority (Enum.RenderPriority). Unbind with UnbindFromRenderStep.

explanation.whatItIs: Your window into the engine's heartbeat. Every frame, the engine fires events you can hook into — and RunService tells you what kind of machine your script is running on.
explanation.whyItExists: Per-frame logic (movement smoothing, timers, custom cameras) needs a reliable 'once per frame' tick with delta time.
whenToUse: Heartbeat: cooldown timers, custom movement, AI ticks, throttled work
RenderStepped: camera control, aim smoothing — anything that must sync with rendering (client only)
Stepped: writing velocities/positions right before physics uses them
whenNotToUse: As a replacement for task.wait in simple delays — task library is cleaner
Heavy work every frame without need — it costs FPS
RenderStepped on the server — it doesn't fire there
explanation.mentalModel:
```text
One frame on the client:
  Stepped ─▶ physics sim ─▶ Heartbeat ─▶ RenderStepped ─▶ render

Server frame:
  Stepped ─▶ physics sim ─▶ Heartbeat

All give you deltaTime: scale movement by it!
pos += velocity * dt   (framerate-independent)
```
tips: Always multiply movement by deltaTime — otherwise speed varies with FPS
Heartbeat is usually the right default; reach for the others deliberately
commonMistakes: Connecting RenderStepped on the server — silently never fires
Frame-dependent movement (no dt multiplication) — speed changes with lag
Accumulating connections every frame/respawn without disconnecting old ones

examples.title: Framerate-independent movement
examples.code:
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local SPEED = 12   -- studs per second

local connection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
    local character = script.Parent
    local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if root then
        root.CFrame += root.CFrame.LookVector * (SPEED * dt)
    end
end)

-- Later:
-- connection:Disconnect()

examples.title: Environment detection
examples.code:
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

if RunService:IsStudio() then
    print("Testing in Studio — use dev data")
end

if RunService:IsServer() then
    print("Server systems boot")
else
    print("Client systems boot")
end
